basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad (IIT (ISM) Dhanbad) has notified 2 project-based vacancies for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Assistant posts with a tenure of Two Year or till end of the Project. Qualifications for these posts vary by post as specified in the official notification. content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad
Prospect Evaluation of Deep Coal Seams of CBM fields under Raniganj East Block
Two Year or till end of the Project
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Assistant
JRF: Rs. 37,000/- per month; Project Assistant: Rs. 25,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The project offers one vacancy each for the Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant positions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: NET/GATE Exemption Criteria for JRF / Ph.D. Admission: Qualifying NET/GATE is not mandatory for applicants if the candidate has done M.Tech/M.E. with First Class/Division or minimum 60% marks/equivalent CGPA; or has done B.Tech/B.E. with minimum CGPA of 8 (on a 10-point scale) or equivalent percentage from any CFTI; or has done B.Tech/B.E. with minimum CGPA of 8 (on a 10-point scale) or equivalent percentage from any Institute/University having 1 to 100th rank in the Overall category in NIRF India rankings (current or previous year). Age Limit and Relaxations: The upper age limit is 28 years at the time of appointment. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable to SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), and female candidates as per GOI/DST rules.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech/ M.Tech/ M.E. in Petroleum Engineering / Chemical Engineering / Environmental Science & Engineering / Geology OR M.Sc. in Chemistry / Geology with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Candidates must qualify NET/GATE for Ph.D. admission unless exempt under specific criteria.

B.Tech/BE in Petroleum Engineering / Chemical Engineering / Environmental Science & Engineering / Geology OR B.Sc. in Chemistry / Geology with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA from a recognized Institute/University under regular program.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure of the project is two years or until the end of the project. The JRF position may be converted into a regular JRF of the Institute at any time as per IIT (ISM) rules. The fellowship/assistantship is fixed at Rs. 37,000/- per month for JRF and Rs. 25,000/- per month for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The objective of the project is the prospect evaluation of the field under study through the physico-chemical and petrographic evaluation of borehole samples. The JRF and Project Assistant will be involved in fulfilling the objectives and other related work as assigned by the PI/Co-PIs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a hard copy of the application along with attested copies of all degree and experience certificates. Mention the project number on the subject of the application. Send the hard copy of the application by speed post to the Principal Investigator. Send a copy of the application through email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible and selected candidates will be called for an interview. The tentative date of the interview is 4 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The interview will be conducted in hybrid mode, although physical presence is preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What positions are available in IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Project Assistant positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one position available for each post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30 October 2026 by 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech, M.Tech, M.E. in Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science & Engineering, Geology, or M.Sc. in Chemistry or Geology with more than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant receives a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years at the time of appointment, with relaxations for reserved categories and female candidates as per GOI/DST rules.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the hard copy of their application with attested certificate copies by speed post and also email it to [email protected] and [email protected], mentioning the project number in the email subject.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The tentative date of the interview is 4 November 2026 at 10:00 AM in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the project title for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The project is titled "Prospect Evaluation of Deep Coal Seams of CBM fields under Raniganj East Block" under ESSAR Oil and Gas Ltd sponsorship.
